Name: CP Hazelnut Treats
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
Hazelnut Treats is a small food mod that adds chocolate hazelnut spread and five new sweets to Stardew Valley.
The spread can be made at home using hazelnut, sugar, and milk, or bought from Pierre’s shop for 300g. Once you have it, you can use it to make pancakes, cookies, a donut, a croissant, and toast.
All of the recipes are unlocked immediately, so you can start cooking as soon as you have access to a kitchen.
[heading][color=#b45f06]What’s included[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Spread [/b][/*]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Pancakes [/b][/*]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Cookies [/b][/*]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Donut [/b][/*]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Croissant [/b][/*]
[*][b]Chocolate Hazelnut Toast [/b][/*]
[/list][b][i]Each item restores energy and health and gives a temporary +1 Speed buff.
The items also have custom villager gift tastes.[/i][/b]

[*][b]Place the [/b][b]folder[/b]
[code][CP] Hazelnut Treats[/code] [b][i]In[/i][/b]

[/b][/u][/i]
